dish_name: baked zucchini stuffed with ground beef and cheese, with rice
components: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Fetch the zucchini, ground beef and cheese from the fridge
steps.checkpoint: zucchini, beef and cheese are on the counter

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Fetch the onion, garlic, canned tomatoes, spices, oil and rice from the pantry
steps.checkpoint: pantry items are on the counter

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Get out the frying pan, baking dish, saucepan, cutting board, knife and spoon

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Wash the zucchini, halve lengthwise and scoop out the flesh with a spoon, keeping the scooped flesh
steps.checkpoint: zucchini boats are hollowed and flesh is set aside

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Peel and dice the onion and mince the garlic
steps.checkpoint: onion is diced and garlic minced

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Grate the cheese if it is not pre-grated
Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear
Put the rice, measured water and a pinch of salt in the saucepan and bring to a boil
Cover and simmer the rice on low heat for about 15 minutes, then rest off the heat
steps.checkpoint: rice is tender and water is absorbed

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Heat oil in the pan and saute the onion and garlic until soft

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Add the ground beef and brown it, breaking it up
steps.checkpoint: beef is browned with no pink left

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Stir in the chopped zucchini flesh, tomatoes, oregano, paprika, salt and pepper and simmer until thick

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Place the zucchini boats in the baking dish and spoon the beef filling into them

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Top the stuffed zucchini with the grated cheese

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Bake for about 25 minutes until the zucchini is tender and the cheese is golden
Fluff the rice with a fork

steps.component: baked stuffed zucchini with ground beef and cheese
steps.text: Plate the stuffed zucchini with rice and serve
steps.checkpoint: stuffed zucchini and rice are on plates
